2607.11849.title: AdvancedMathBench: A Benchmark Suite for Advanced Mathematical Proof Generation and Verification
2607.11849.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on high-school and olympiad-style mathematics, yet their capabilities on advanced mathematics remain poorly understood. Existing benchmarks, however, fall short in both scope and evaluation granularity: they provide limited disciplinary coverage and often rely on final-answer correctness or coarse judgments, leaving the validity of the reasoning process inadequately assessed. To bridge this gap, we introduce AdvancedMathBench, a benchmark suite designed to evaluate advanced mathematical reasoning capabilities. Its core proof-generation benchmark, ProverBench, contains 296 problems spanning undergraduate and doctoral qualifying-exam levels. To provide reliable evaluation of the proofs, we develop a dedicated automatic verification pipeline trained on large-scale expert annotations to produce both correctness verdicts and fine-grained assessments of proof errors, which exhibits strong agreement with human experts on held-out proof trajectories. We further introduce VerifierBench, consisting of 888 model-generated proof trajectories paired with expert ground truth, to evaluate whether models can correctly judge proof validity and provide sound verification rationales. Experiments show that AdvancedMathBench remains challenging for frontier models. On proof generation, the best-performing model, GPT-5.5-xhigh, achieves only 75.8 and 66.1 on the UGD and QE splits, respectively, indicating substantial room for improvement on advanced mathematical proof construction. On proof verification, the best model attains a Balanced F1 of only 65.1, and models generally exhibit low true negative rates, suggesting that critical error detection remains a major bottleneck.
2607.11849.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在高中和奧林匹克風格的數學上取得了顯著的表現，但它們在高級數學方面的能力仍然不甚了解。現有的基準測試在範疇和評估的細緻度上都存在不足：它們提供的學科覆蓋有限，且通常依賴於最終答案的正確性或粗略的判斷，導致推理過程的有效性未能得到充分評估。為了填補這一空白，我們推出了AdvancedMathBench，這是一個旨在評估高級數學推理能力的基準套件。其核心的證明生成基準ProverBench包含296個問題，涵蓋本科和博士資格考試的水平。為了提供可靠的證明評估，我們開發了一個專門的自動驗證管道，該管道基於大規模專家註釋進行訓練，以產生正確性判斷和對證明錯誤的細緻評估，並與人類專家在保留的證明路徑上顯示出強一致性。我們進一步推出了VerifierBench，包含888個模型生成的證明路徑，並配有專家的真實數據，以評估模型是否能正確判斷證明的有效性並提供合理的驗證理由。實驗顯示，AdvancedMathBench對前沿模型仍然具有挑戰性。在證明生成方面，表現最佳的模型GPT-5.5-xhigh在UGD和QE分割上僅達到75.8和66.1，顯示出在高級數學證明構建方面仍有相當大的改進空間。在證明驗證方面，最佳模型的平衡F1僅為65.1，且模型通常表現出低的真負率，這表明關鍵錯誤檢測仍然是一個主要瓶頸。
